data.spec: Delivery logic implemented: event IDs hash request+status+(full proposal snapshot for approval) or incident+status; database durable across process. Startup existing state visible but outbound skipped; disabled history never replayed when configured later. Before pending approval send, authoritative request must still await same proposal snapshot; otherwise skipped. Persist uncertain before Twilio HTTP; transport/5xx/ambiguous responses remain uncertain with no auto retry. sent means provider accepted, not delivery confirmation. Payload excludes transcript/person/model reasoning, includes exact quote total and simulation label. Outbound channel defaults off; docs/feedback.md config. No message handler can approve/execute spending.
